title: Next/Link in global not-found page not working

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: Linking and Navigating
labels.description: Related to Next.js linking (e.g., <Link>) and navigation.

body:
### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

```bash
Operating System:
      Platform: linux
      Arch: x64
      Version: #22 SMP Tue Jan 10 18:39:00 UTC 2023
    Binaries:
      Node: 18.14.2
      npm: 9.5.0
      Yarn: 1.22.19
      pnpm: N/A
    Relevant packages:
      next: 13.4.2-canary.4
      eslint-config-next: 13.4.0
      react: 18.2.0
      react-dom: 18.2.0
      typescript: 4.9.4
```


### Which area(s) of Next.js are affected? (leave empty if unsure)

App directory (appDir: true), Routing (next/router, next/navigation, next/link)

### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/festive-haze-sxcwdh

### To Reproduce

Create a global not-found page in app directory and add Next/Link there to navigate from it to non 404 page. When clicking on the Next/Link component url does get updated but the content stays the same, so you still see 404 page even though the url is showing you should be on the new page.

### Describe the Bug

Not able to use Next/Link in global not-found page

### Expected Behavior

I would be able to navigate to different pages without an issue from global not found page.

### Which browser are you using? (if relevant)

Chrome

### How are you deploying your application? (if relevant)

Self, Codebox
